notes: Method: rows are the costed subset the critic's section 7 item 1 ('verify-completion... re-key the 271 SKIPPED_TRIAGE rows to section features and verify the sixty or so named in section 1, in this order') plus the rows section 1 names individually with a feature but section 7 does not repeat ([477], [492], [494], [495], all feature 1). Section 7's order was followed: the feature-12 rows, the feature-41 rows, the plainness defence, Russ 1971, Budrys, Hilliard, the Thrust 1983 fourteen, 'Nor the Summers as Golden' (seven), Gordon 1986 (thirteen), Attebery and Garvey (six). CONFIRMED: the counts reproduce exactly against state-wolfe.json when the skipped rows are grouped by source - Thrust 1983 = 14 rows [950, 953-955, 957, 959, 960, 962, 963, 966-970], 'Nor the Summers as Golden' = 7 [827, 828, 831-835], Gordon 1986 = 13 [772-776, 782-786, 801, 804, 805], Attebery 3 [789-791] + Garvey 3 [766, 767, 770] = 6. TWO ROWS THE CRITIC NAMES ARE NOT SKIPPED: section 7 lists 'the feature-41 rows (558, 561, 563, 485, 824)', but [485] and [824] are VERIFIED_VERBATIM - section 2 of the same critic already files them among the 116 kept rows 'mentioned nowhere in a feature paragraph' (Wright/Searles and Hassler on whether there is a story under the glittering edifice). They need citing, not verifying. Full exclusion list: 485=VERIFIED_VERBATIM, 824=VERIFIED_VERBATIM. Ranges expanded: 527-530, 831-835, 772-776, 782-786, 789-791. Adjacent skipped rows deliberately left out because the critic's counts exclude them, but which a verify pass over the same document should pick up: [948] and [972] are two further Thrust 19 rows under different source strings (the critic counts 14 Wolfe-primary rows, so these are the interviewer's and the sub-titled interview's); [826] is an eighth 'Nor the Summers as Golden' row under a different source string; [780], [781] are Wolfe quoted in Gordon 1986; [769], [771] are Wright and Andre-Driussi quoted by Garvey. The remaining ~207 skipped rows are, in the critic's words, 'biography and duplicates'. The other source clusters section 1 names but does not put in the costed order are, with their skipped rows: Auerbach 8 [492, 494-500] (three of them already here), Clute SFE 8 [806-810, 812-814], Ewing 6 [528-533], Howell 6 [615-620], Aramini SFBC 2020 6 [855-858, 864, 865], Robinson 6 [886, 887, 892, 894, 895, 899], Bebergal 5 [477-481], Keller 5 [521-523, 525, 526], Locus 2002 [685-687, 689, 697] + [937-939], Andre-Driussi [915-918, 921] + [910-912], Crampton 5 [924-927, 932]. The wolfe section itself carries no per-feature WITNESS SKIPPED lines (unlike section-dnd.md): it states only that the 271 skipped rows 'are not cited', so the critic is the sole naming authority for this sweep.
